question:
Select the correctly spelt word to fill in the blank.

My grandmother ______________ the preparation of every festival celebration in my house.
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 1**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"initiates"** means to begin, set going, or originate. (आरंभ करना) • **Example: **The teacher initiates the lesson with a brief introduction to the topic. • **"Initiates" **refers to the act of starting or setting in motion. (आरंभ करना) • **Example: **My grandmother initiates the preparation of every festival celebration in my house. • Hence, we can infer that the correct spelling is **'initiates'**. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.
